div.head: I Em 4
div.ab: Se þe wið nunnan hæme, gehalgodre legerstowe ne sy he wyrðe — buton he gebete — þe ma þe manslaga; þæt ilce we cwædon be æwbrice.
Se ðe wið nunnan hæme, gehalgodre legerstowe ne sy he wyrðe—bute he gebete—ðe ma ðe mánslaga; ðæt hylce we cwædon be æwbryce.
Se ðe wið nunnan hæme, gehalgodre legerstowe ne sy he wyrðe — bute he gebete — ðe ma ðe manslaga; þæt ylce we cwædan be æwbryce.
Qui cum nunna (uel sanctimoniali) fornicabitur, sanctificato atrio sit indignus, nisi emendet, sicut homicida; sic idem diximus de eƿbrice (id est adulterio uel infracto coniugio).
[Be nunna hæmede ⁊ forlygre.] Se þe wið nunnan hæme, gehalgodre legerstowe ne sy he wyrðe—buton he gebete—þe ma þe manslaga; þæt ilce we cwædon be æwbrice.
Se þe wið nunnan hæme, gehalgodre legerstowe ne sy he wyrðe—buton he gebete—þe ma þe manslaga. Þæt ilce we cwædon be æwbrice.
(Von Nonnenunzucht und Ehebruch. Ld) Wer mit einer Nonne hurt, der sei — ausser wenn er büsst — geweihter Grabesstätte nicht mehr würdig als ein Todtschläger; dasselbe bestimmten wir über Ehebruch.

(Of fornication with nuns and adultery. Ld) Whoever fornicates with a nun, let him be — unless he makes amends — no more worthy of a consecrated burial-place than a homicide; we determined the same concerning adultery.
He who has intercourse with a nun, unless he make amends, shall not be allowed burial in consecrated ground any more than a homicide. We have decreed the same with regard to adultery.
Anyone who has intercourse with a nun cannot—without repentance—be buried in consecrated ground any more than can a murderer. We have decreed the same concerning adultery.
